content.text:
No. The pendulum strikes ball1 at 0.35 s, and ball1 successfully rolls down ramp1 and hits cart1 at 1.14 s. Cart1 then reaches domino1 at 1.86 s, but the domino only rocks about 4° and settles upright. It never touches flap1, so flap1 and ball2 remain stationary. Ball1 falls to the floor and eventually stops.

The untested revision below puts the domino’s **0.04 m thickness along the travel direction**, lowers it to the floor, and raises the cart’s contact band to improve tipping leverage. It also repositions flap1 and ball2 accordingly. The approximate-slide and numerical-restitution limitations remain.
